flora: Dicksoniaceous Ferns (large, architectural, sub-tree ferns with thick, fibrous trunks)
Massive, arching fronds with deeply dissected, repetitive leaflets
Large unfurling fiddleheads near the trunk apex
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; trunks must look like columns of woven brown fiber or hair; fronds are bold and feather-like with clean, simplified geometric leaflets; maintain a lush, humid, tropical look with soft-edged geometry.

visual_logic.composition: A low-angle view looking upward from the base of a giant Dicksoniaceous fern. Its massive green fronds arch gracefully outward like an emerald umbrella, silhouetted against a soft-focus background of the lake valley.
visual_logic.ground: Soft, moist ash gray earth covered in dark humus mulch and thick, velvety cushions of lime-green liverwort mats.
visual_logic.lighting: SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC; warm, backlight filtering through the translucent green leaflets, making the fronds glow with internal light.
